title: Wings Notification Hub manifest
description: Notification configuration a Wings Code generated application registers during deployment (POST /api/v1/registrations/manifest, scope applications.register). Registration is an idempotent upsert keyed by application code. Mirrors Wings.NotificationHub.Contracts.NotificationManifest (JSON camelCase; the hub reads property names case-insensitively).

$schema.description: Editor hint; ignored by the hub.

companies.description: Codes of companies (in the registering tenant) that may use the application. Unknown codes are skipped with a warning.

channels.description: Channels the application may use (application allow-list). When non-empty, every template's channel must be listed here.

templates.description: Registered as Draft versions that go through review/approval (auto-approved only for sandbox applications). An unchanged subject/body is not re-registered.

webhooks.description: Webhook subscriptions to create (an existing subscription with the same URL is left alone). Signing secrets of new subscriptions are returned once in webhookSecrets.

credential.description: Create a client credential when the application has none (the secret is returned once).

channel.description: Lower-case wire name. The hub also accepts different casing and the aliases in_app, in-app, web_push, mobilepush, browserpush.

messageClass.description: Transactional: essential messages about a transaction. Promotional: needs marketing consent, honours unsubscribe. Critical: security/regulatory, ignores opt-out preferences.

code.description: Stable application code (idempotency key of the registration), e.g. WINGS-FIELD-SERVICE.

sandbox.description: Sandbox applications are routed to mock providers only and their templates are auto-approved (pre-deployment testing).

code.description: Notification type code used by send requests, e.g. JOB_ASSIGNED.

category.description: Preference category shown to recipients (e.g. Invoice, Approval).

defaultTemplateCode.description: Template used when a send request names only the notification type.

events.description: Business event types (e.g. job.assigned) that raise this notification; documentation and rule wiring.

aiAllowed.description: May AI agents (MCP) send this type?

sampleValue.description: Used for previews and test sends.

body.description: Template text with {{Variable}} placeholders, filters ({{Amount | currency:INR}}) and {{#if}} blocks.

url.description: https only (http is accepted only on hubs configured with Webhooks:AllowHttp, i.e. development).

scopes.description: Defaults to the application scopes. applications.register is never allowed here.
